generate_requesters_docs: run the main function to auto-generate a Markdown documentation file for all Mephisto requester types
list_valid_requester_types: get the list of all valid provider types registered in the Mephisto operations registry
get_requester_cli_args: retrieve the CLI argument definitions for a specific Mephisto requester type using get_wut_arguments
add_requester_args_table: add a formatted table of argument information for a requester to a Markdown document using add_object_args_table_info
create_requesters_reference_md: generate the requesters.md reference documentation file under docs/web/docs/reference/ with headers and argument tables for each requester
